newsitem.title: USA: Analog Devices's chairman drops CEO role.
newsitem.headline: Analog Devices's chairman drops CEO role.

text.p: Analog Devices said on Friday that Jerald Fishman, Analog's president and chief operating officer, would become the company's president and chief executive officer effective November 2.
Ray Stata, the company's founder, chairman and chief executive officer would remain full-time chairman of the board, the company said.
November 2 is the last day of the company's current fiscal year.

Analog said Fishman began his career at Analog Devices in 1972 in product marketing. Over the next several years he held a series of management positions in marketing, operations and strategic planning, the company said. He was named president and COO in 1991.
